summary: Iteration 3 BACKEND-ONLY verification after MongoDB projection optimization on /api/admin/sales. All 8 pytest cases PASS (8/8, 100%). No regression: GET /api/routes returns 11 routes; GET /api/payments/providers returns {stripe:true, mercadopago:true, flow:true, price_clp:3000}. Admin sales endpoint works correctly: (1) 401 with missing header, wrong key, or empty key; (2) 200 with header X-Admin-Key: RAPANUI-2026; (3) also accepts ?key= query param (200); (4) response shape validated: total_clp is int (>=0), sales_count is int, pending_count is int, by_provider is dict of provider -> {count:int, total_clp:int}, recent is list <=30 items each with provider(str), amount_clp(int), paid_at, device_id(str, truncated <=14 chars). Consistency invariants hold: sum(by_provider.count) == sales_count and sum(by_provider.total_clp) == total_clp. Sample response from public URL: {"total_clp":5000,"sales_count":2,"pending_count":13,"by_provider":{"stripe":{"count":2,"total_clp":5000}},"recent":[...]} — projection is working (only provider, amount_clp, paid_at, device_id are returned per doc, no _id leaked).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:387-390 uses correct MongoDB projection {provider:1, amount_clp:1, paid_at:1, device_id:1} which excludes _id from the fetched documents implicitly at Python level (never returned in response). Optimization looks safe.
Sort key .sort('paid_at', -1) — items with paid_at=None could reorder unpredictably but does not affect current tests. Non-blocking.
Endpoint accepts key via header OR query param; both paths return 401 when ADMIN_KEY env is empty (defensive). Behavior verified.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_sales.py (new file, 8 tests dedicated to admin sales projection optimization + minimal regression on /routes and /payments/providers)
